pastMonthNotice: You are viewing {month}. Anything you log is dated today and joins the open settlement.

close.body: Close this settlement to file it away. The next one opens straight away, and anything you log from now on joins it.
close.dialogBody: Everything logged so far is filed under this settlement and stays there. A new settlement opens immediately — a late shared expense joins that one, not this one. Closed settlements cannot be reopened.

ops.sharedThen: Log it as a normal expense — {partner}'s 32% is added to what she owes you automatically.
ops.paidBackWhen: {partner} sends you money / pays you back
ops.paidBackThen: Add → "{partner} paid me" (or "Record payment" here). It lowers what she owes you — whatever you do with the money after is separate.
ops.frontedThen: "+ I owe {partner}" here — your share. It raises what you owe her.
ops.payHerWhen: You end up owing {partner}, so you pay her
ops.cardWhen: You pay off a credit card
ops.cardThen: Add → Card payment. It just records the payment — it doesn't touch the settlement balance.
ops.owesWhen: {partner} owes you money without a shared expense
ops.owesThen: "+ {partner} owes me" records the full debt. It adds no expense, income, or payment.
ops.zeroThen: Both debt actions remain available. Record payment appears only when a balance remains.

lines.partner_debt: Debts you logged as "{partner} owes me"

views.openEmpty: This settlement is empty — nothing has been logged since the last close.
views.monthPast: {month} has ended. This is what it held — the open settlement is on its own tab.
views.monthFuture: {month} has not started. This is what is already dated to it — the open settlement is on its own tab.
views.monthEmpty: No shared expenses or transfers in {month}.
views.historyEmpty: No settlement was closed in {month}. When a balance reaches zero you can close it, and it is filed under the month you closed it in.
views.closedEmpty: This settlement closed with no rows in it.

journal.title: Movement journal
journal.loadDebtError: Couldn't load that debt. Please refresh.

errors.notSettled: This settlement isn't square yet, so it can't be closed.
errors.noMarker: This settlement can't be closed yet: closing marks a payment or transfer with your partner, and this one holds neither.
errors.markerGone: The row that would close this settlement is no longer there. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.dbError: Could not close the settlement. Please try again.
